claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Witness only reports blue metal drums with lids and side bungs/ports; no markings or certification shown to confirm suitability for all liquids.
No readable labels/brand/spec markings or food-grade certification visible in the report.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No internal condition photos, cleaning proof, or residue/odor indicators are shown; only exterior scuffs/discoloration are mentioned.
The report notes minor surface wear/discoloration but does not include leak test results or close-ups of seams/welds.
Lids are visible, but the report does not confirm gaskets are intact or that all bungs/caps are included and functional.

risks.risk: Unknown drum capacity/size and dimensions, which strongly affects value and transport cost
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the drum capacity marking (e.g., 50L/100L/200L) or a tape-measure shot of height and diameter, plus the bung size/position.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used metal drums with unknown capacity (worst-case for buyer value).

risks.risk: Food-grade claim may be false; prior contents could contaminate (even if used for water once)
risks.proof: Photos of any readable certification/markings (food-grade/UN/HDPE/steel spec) and an interior shot showing cleanliness (no residue) and intact lining (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-certified used drums (worst-case: not guaranteed food-grade).

risks.risk: Leak/crack status not proven; exterior scuffs/discoloration could hide dents, seam issues, or pinholes
risks.proof: A short video of a leak test (fill with water and show no seepage) or close-up photos of weld seams and around bungs/lids with gaskets.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing inspection/repair (worst-case: treat as not confirmed leak-free).

risks.risk: Bungs/caps/gaskets may be missing or not sealing properly
risks.proof: Photo(s) showing each bung/cap present, plus a close-up of the bung threads and gasket condition; include a shot of any loose accessories included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as drums without guaranteed sealing accessories (worst-case: may require replacement parts).

risks.risk: Quantity/spec mismatch: not all drums may be the same size/spec
risks.proof: A count shot showing the total quantity and a side-by-side photo of multiple drums confirming identical markings/dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/uncertain specification (worst-case: assume variability).

risks.risk: Rust-through or internal corrosion not visible from exterior photos
risks.proof: Interior inspection photo (open bung/lid and show inside) and close-up of bottom rims/edges where corrosion starts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used drums with possible corrosion risk (worst-case: assume unknown internal condition).

proof_requests: Clear photos of any readable markings: capacity (L), steel spec, brand, and any food-grade/approval stamps.
Interior photos (through bung/lid opening) showing cleanliness and whether there is lining/residue.
Close-up photos of weld seams, bottom edges, and around lids/bungs (including gaskets).
A short leak-test video (fill with water and show no seepage) or evidence of pressure/leak testing.
Photos confirming all bungs/caps are included and present on each drum (and their condition).
A shot showing total quantity and confirmation that all drums match the same size/spec.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type (blue metal drums with lids and side bungs) but key pricing drivers—capacity, food-grade/previous contents proof, and leak-free condition—are not verifiable from the report. Without those, a worst-case price would be unreliable; request the specific proof items above first.
